w10_T4_002531: A juice company had 222 crates of bottles in its warehouse. It shipped 61 crates to a supermarket, and each crate left behind held 9 bottles, so the company recounted its stock in bottles. A quality check found 743 dented bottles, which were thrown out. Every remaining bottle was sold for 7 dollars, and a grateful customer added a 9-dollar tip to that day's total. Over the next 7 days the company took in that same daily amount each day. The morning shift lasted two hours, which is one hundred twenty minutes, and the warehouse has 14 loading docks. How many dollars did the company take in altogether over those 7 days?
w10_T4_002533: Priya had 37 sheets of stickers, more than her friend Leo had. She gave 14 sheets to Leo. Each sheet Priya kept had 6 stickers on it, so she peeled them all off and started counting individual stickers. She used 98 stickers to decorate her notebook. Then Leo handed her 46 stickers back, and her aunt gave her 43 more. Priya now has more stickers than Leo. How many stickers does Priya have now?
w10_T4_002535: Marcus collected 230 bottle caps a day for 8 days for a recycling contest, far more than his sister Dana managed. He traded 997 of his caps to Dana for a comic book. The contest awards 7 points for every cap Marcus still has. He spent 5644 points on a skateboard. Each remaining point can be swapped for 4 arcade tokens, and each token is worth 4 cents. Marcus knows a hundred cents make one dollar, but he keeps his tally in cents. How many cents are Marcus's tokens worth in total?
w10_T4_002538: Nadia had 21 dollars in her savings jar, less than her cousin Omar had in his. Her grandmother added 40 dollars to the jar. Nadia put the whole jar into her stall at the school business fair, and the stall paid back 7 dollars for every dollar she put in, all of which went into the jar as her new savings. She then spent 12 dollars from the jar on a book. After that her uncle took everything out of the jar to the bank and came back with 4 dollars for each dollar he had taken, putting all of it into the jar. Omar now has less than Nadia. How many dollars are in Nadia's jar now?
w10_T4_002540: Farmer Elsa collected 198 eggs on Monday, while her neighbor Tom collected fewer. She sold 47 eggs at the farm gate, gave 10 to Tom, sold 103 to a bakery, and found that 8 had cracked in the cart. Her hens are 3 years old and lay well. She sold every egg she had left to a cafe at 9 cents apiece, and the cafe owner added a 32-cent tip. How many cents did Elsa receive from the cafe in total?
w10_T4_002547: Jonah practised the piano for 53 minutes on each of 6 days this week. His teacher only counts time spent on new pieces, and 240 of those minutes, four whole hours as Jonah noted, went on scales instead. On Sunday Jonah added 74 more minutes on a new piece. The teacher awards 2 points for every counted minute. Jonah's sister Ruth earned fewer points than he did this week. How many points did Jonah earn?
w10_T4_002551: In the morning Sam arrived at the arcade with 101 dollars, more than his friend Ivy had brought. He found 6 dollars on the floor and added them to his wallet. At the counter he exchanged every dollar he had for 2 tokens each. In the afternoon he spent 82 tokens on racing games and won 5 tokens back from a claw machine. In the evening the arcade ran a happy hour: a bonus machine paid out 8 tokens for every token fed into it, and Sam fed in all of his tokens and kept the payout. Ivy ended the day with fewer tokens than Sam. How many tokens did Sam have at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_002552: In the morning Lena arrived at the quiz show with 124 dollars of prize money already banked. Before taping began she was credited 56 dollars for a warm-up round and 66 dollars for a bonus puzzle. In the afternoon she staked all her prize money on a single question and got it right; the show keeps the stake and pays out 4 dollars for every dollar staked, so that payout became her new total. In the evening final she staked her whole total again under the same rule, this time receiving 3 dollars for every dollar staked as her new total. The studio audience numbered 350 people. After paying 1310 dollars in fees on the way out, how many dollars did Lena have left?
w10_T4_002556: A charity fun run had 210 runners registered in each of its 4 age groups. On the day, 73 more runners signed up at the desk. A dozen volunteers handed out water along the route, which was 10 kilometres long. Every runner who took part raised 5 dollars for the charity. After the run, three local shops donated 45 dollars, 35 dollars, and 53 dollars. How many dollars did the charity receive in total?
w10_T4_002560: In the morning a chocolate factory's crew of a dozen workers packed 146 boxes for shipping. In the afternoon they packed 32 more boxes. Every box holds 9 cartons, every carton holds 7 packs, every pack holds 4 bars, and every bar is scored into 8 squares. In the evening the auditor spent ninety minutes, an hour and a half, checking the whole shipment square by square. How many squares of chocolate did the day's boxes contain in total?
w10_T4_002569: At a festival, Rosa's coffee cart served 82 cups in each of the 4 hours it was open on Friday. Each cup was priced at 9 dollars, and Rosa keeps her books in dollars rather than cents, since a hundred cents make a dollar. Across the whole weekend her takings came to triple Friday's total. A regular customer also handed her an 80-dollar tip at closing time. How many dollars did Rosa take in over the weekend, including the tip?
w10_T4_002572: In the morning a bakery set out 188 cookies, and 33 of them sold before noon. In the afternoon the baker made 72 more cookies and added them to the display. The oven was set to 180 degrees the whole day. In the evening, for a tasting event, every cookie on the display was cut into 5 bite-sized pieces. The pieces were then packed into sample bags of 5 pieces each. How many sample bags were packed?
w10_T4_002574: Aisha stores her stamp collection on 13 shelves, and each shelf holds 6 boxes with 4 folders in every box. Over the summer she bought enough new folders to triple the number of folders she owned. Every folder contains 6 sheets, and every sheet holds 5 stamps, with all the folders full. Her brother Rafi has far fewer stamps than Aisha. How many stamps does Aisha have?
w10_T4_002582: Tom's wallet was empty at the start of the week. He worked 6 days at a bakery and was paid 32 dollars each day, putting every dollar into the wallet. He found 5 dollars on the pavement and added them too. Then he spent 185 dollars from the wallet on a secondhand bike, and his grandmother tucked 9 dollars into it for his birthday. At the fair he fed everything in the wallet into a token machine that gives a token for every 3 dollars. How many tokens did Tom get?
w10_T4_002584: The chess club's fund held 186 dollars, and the club spent 141 dollars on a new banner. At a meeting that lasted half an hour, the remaining money was shared equally among the club's 5 members, one of whom was Ben. Ben spent 4 dollars of his share on a snack. He then used every dollar he had left to buy raffle tickets at 5 tickets per dollar. His clubmate Zoe bought fewer tickets than Ben. How many raffle tickets did Ben buy?
w10_T4_002586: A concert hall has 2 tiers, and each tier has 183 rows with 9 seats in every row. For Saturday's show every seat was sold at 6 dollars. The show ran for one hundred and eighty minutes, that is, three hours. The band has 5 members. The organisers paid 9470 dollars in costs out of the ticket money. How many dollars did the organisers have left after costs?
w10_T4_002591: A gardener raised 95 tomato seedlings, but 35 of them wilted and were discarded. She planted the survivors in 6 equal rows along the fence. Each plant in a row takes 6 minutes to water by hand, and she waters every plant once a day for the 7 days of the week. She knows an hour is sixty minutes, but she keeps her watering log in minutes, and she usually finishes before half past seven. How many minutes does she spend watering one row over the week?
w10_T4_002594: In the morning Dev's bakery received 141 kilograms of flour, and 88 kilograms went into the breakfast pastries. In the afternoon he turned every remaining kilogram into 6 loaves, and each loaf sold for 6 dollars before closing. In the evening he paid 690 dollars in wages out of the loaf money. He then gave half of what remained to his business partner Nia and kept the rest, so Dev and Nia ended the day with equal amounts. How many dollars did Dev keep?
w10_T4_002601: Mia's prepaid phone plan started the month with 158 minutes of call time. She used 112 minutes calling her grandmother, then topped up with a pack of 56 minutes. The carrier added a 30-minute loyalty bonus. She then spent 66 minutes on a work call. Mia knows sixty minutes make an hour, but her plan tracks everything in minutes. How many minutes of call time does Mia have left?
w10_T4_002602: In the morning a florist had 26 bunches of roses, and a delivery brought 22 more bunches. Each bunch holds 8 roses, so she loosened them all into a single display bucket. By the afternoon she had sold half of the roses in the bucket, and a second delivery added 80 loose roses. In the evening a wedding order took 96 roses, and a customer returned 13 roses that had been ordered by mistake. The shop has 4 display windows facing the street. How many roses were in the bucket at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_002606: Leo planted 21 bean seeds in the spring, but 3 of them never sprouted. Each plant that grew produced 7 pods, and every pod held 5 beans, all of which Leo saved as seed. He bought 43 more beans from his neighbour Mira, who had harvested fewer than he had. A dozen weeks later he planted every bean he had; this time each bean grew into a plant with 8 pods, and every pod held 6 beans. Leo again kept every bean as seed. How many beans does Leo have after the second harvest?
w10_T4_002607: At half past six in the morning, a newspaper depot sent out 9 carriers, each with 201 papers. By the afternoon, 234 papers had come back unsold and the rest had been sold. The depot earns 8 cents on every paper sold, and it counts its takings in cents even though a hundred cents make a dollar. In the evening the cashier changed all the day's cents into nickels, each nickel being worth 5 cents. How many nickels did the cashier end up with?
w10_T4_002609: Hana set up a lemonade stand in the morning with 104 paper cups, and she sold 41 cups before ten and another 18 by noon. In the afternoon she sold 26 cups to a passing football team and 15 to a group of joggers, and 1 cup blew away in the wind. Each cup of lemonade cost 2 dollars. In the evening her father brought her a fresh pack of 77 cups. Her brother Kai, who ran a stand across the street, sold fewer cups than Hana all day. How many cups did Hana have at the end of the evening?
w10_T4_002613: A scout troop is organised into 14 patrols with 4 scouts in each. Half of the scouts went on the weekend hike, and they were joined by 64 scouts from a neighbouring troop. Every hiker carried 7 litres of water, and the leaders brought an extra 49 litres in a trailer. The trail was 11 kilometres long. How many litres of water did the hiking party carry in total?
w10_T4_002615: A toy factory employed 232 workers and hired 77 more for the holiday rush. Every worker assembles 9 toy cars an hour and works a 5-hour shift each day, three hundred minutes as the notice board puts it. The factory floor has 3 assembly lines. The workers kept this up for 7 days, and a trial batch added 71 more cars. Quality control then rejected 22427 cars. How many cars passed quality control?
